date.as_written: saṃvat 1828 śāke 16 jyeṣṭhamāse yakṣmapakṣe tithau pratipadi bhauma(5)vāsare

notes: No persons mentioned. The date gives both Saṃvat 1828 and an incomplete Śāka year ('śāke 16', likely for Śaka 1693, which corresponds to VS 1828 / 1771 CE). 'yakṣmapakṣe' is likely an error for kṛṣṇa- or śuklapakṣa.
